modernizationPaths.description: Replace JSF Facelets and EJB backing beans with a React SPA communicating over REST/JSON JAX-RS endpoints. The existing EJB services, DAOs, and JPA entities are retained with minimal change. The session bean scope problem and table-based layout disappear naturally. Optimal choice when team has existing JEE knowledge and wants to minimise backend disruption.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Decompose JSF managed bean actions into JAX-RS endpoints; migrate faces-config navigation to React Router; replace JSF session scope with JWT or cookie-based auth; rebuild PrimeFaces data table pagination in React; establish a CORS/security filter layer between SPA and Liberty.

modernizationPaths.description: Full platform replacement: React SPA frontend plus Quarkus RESTEasy Reactive backend replacing both JSF and the EJB container. JPA entities can be reused with Panache or as-is. Yields the most modern stack and best runtime efficiency, but requires the highest coordination effort across both layers simultaneously.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Migrate EJB Stateless to Quarkus CDI beans and remove javax EJB annotations; replace JTA transactions with Quarkus transaction interceptors; port H2 datasource config from Liberty server.xml to application.properties; rework session auth to Quarkus Security with JWT; parallel frontend and backend migration increases delivery risk.

modernizationPaths.description: Vue.js SPA replaces the JSF view layer while the JEE backend exposes JAX-RS endpoints reusing existing EJB services and JPA entities. Vue's Options API offers a gentler learning curve for teams accustomed to JSF's declarative style. Incremental migration possible by exposing REST endpoints alongside JSF pages during transition.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Design RESTful API contract from existing managed bean methods; manage Vuex or Pinia state to replace JSF session-scoped bean data; adapt PrimeFaces table/pagination to Vue component library; handle multipart form posts for document path field; update Liberty CSP headers to allow SPA asset serving.

modernizationPaths.description: Vue.js frontend with Quarkus backend. Quarkus dev services simplify the H2 datasource migration and provide hot reload during development. Suitable for teams wanting a modern JVM microservice without a full cloud-native commitment. Combined replacement of both JSF and EJB container is the primary risk.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Replace javax EJB lifecycle with Quarkus CDI and ApplicationScoped services; migrate JTA-managed EntityManager to Quarkus JPA; rebuild dead SOAP CitizenRegistryService as MicroProfile REST Client; establish OpenAPI contract between Vue SPA and Quarkus endpoints; containerise both tiers for consistent deployment.

modernizationPaths.description: Angular replaces JSF Facelets; the JEE backend exposes JAX-RS REST endpoints backed by the existing EJB services and JPA layer. Angular's opinionated structure (modules, services, forms) maps naturally onto the existing layered architecture. Preferred when the team needs strong TypeScript typing and built-in form validation to replace JSF validators.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Map JSF managed bean validation rules to Angular Reactive Forms validators; replace faces-config navigation with Angular Router guards and canActivate auth checks; integrate Angular HttpClient with JAX-RS CORS policy on Liberty; migrate PrimeFaces p:dataTable to Angular Material or PrimeNG; adopt Angular build pipeline alongside Liberty WAR build.

modernizationPaths.description: Angular frontend with Quarkus backend — the most comprehensive modernisation path. Fully removes the javax.faces, EJB, and JTA dependency chain. Results in a containerisable, GraalVM-compatible stack. High initial investment but produces the most maintainable and scalable outcome. Recommended only when the team can dedicate sustained effort to a phased migration.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Complete removal of JSF, PrimeFaces, EJB, and JTA requires parallel rewrite of all four layers; DataInitializer startup logic must be ported to Quarkus Flyway or Liquibase migrations; Angular module federation needed for incremental strangler-fig delivery; CitizenRegistryService SOAP stub migration to MicroProfile REST Client; build, CI, and deployment pipelines need full redesign.
